mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 60-day SPX returns is negative or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 8.0% signals economic weakness and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) below 1500 and retail sales (RSAFS) below 540000 signal a broad-based demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST < 1500 and RSAFS < 540000.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 indicates a supply shock, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A rising payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between PAYEMS and 20-day SPX returns is negative or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1500 signals a weakening housing market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1500.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 259.5 and stable federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) at or above 0.1% signals the onset of monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 259.5 and FEDFUNDS >= 0.1.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a strengthening supply side, supporting economic growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between INDPRO and 60-day SPX returns is negative or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
